text:
Maya Chen: Quick follow-up on the postmortem for the missing spans + bad aggregation. Postmortem doc here: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/OBS-321. I pulled the recurring pattern stats — spans seem to dip roughly every 72h. Need owners for remediation items and clear timelines.

Ben Ortiz: I can take the ETL lag remediation (OBS-334). Found a retry storm in the backfill job that queues duplicate batches. Will open a PR to add idempotency and backpressure. Targeting PR by EOD Thu. :+1:

Liam Patel: I'll own the aggregation keys bug (OBS-335) — looks like a change in the rollup window math introduced a rounding issue. Repro steps below. I'll aim for a canary deploy next Tue and a rollback plan.

Sophia Rivera: I'll put the recurring span-coverage check on a cron job and add alerts if drops > 15% vs baseline. Proposed schedule: every Monday 06:00 UTC. Also can add a short-run playbook for oncall.

Maya Chen: Thanks. Can we map these to short deadlines? Ben Thu EOD for PR, Liam Tue canary, Sophia Mon cron + runbook by Friday? Confirm owners and I'll add to the postmortem follow-up board.

Ben Ortiz: Confirmed. PR will be 4123, branch name: fix/etl-idempotency-OBS-334. I'll add tests and a perf baseline.

Liam Patel: Confirmed. Will open PR 4127 and include the rollback flag in the deploy. Test plan: compare rollup counts over last 7 days, verify no drift.

Sophia Rivera: Confirmed. I'll add runbook stub: steps to validate span ingest, quick query to find recent drops, and contact list.

Maya Chen: Small note — we saw an old config flip around the same time as the first regression. @Liam please check config history for the grouping-key flag.

Liam Patel: Good call. I already traced it to a kubeconfig update on 2026-03-09 that changed ENV_ROLLUP_WINDOW from 60 -> 59. Will include that in the RCA.

Maya Chen: Can someone add remediation owners to the postmortem doc and set statuses? I want to show progress in the Monday exec checkin.

Ben Ortiz: Done — updated OBS-334 section with owner, PR link, and ETA.

incident-bot: reminder scheduled — follow-up check on OBS-321/334/335 in 7 days.

Sophia Rivera: One more quick helper query I'll add to the runbook for span coverage checks:
```sql
-- quick span coverage: counts per service for last 24h
SELECT service_name, count(*) as spans
FROM spans
WHERE received_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY service_name
ORDER BY spans DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

Maya Chen: Perfect. Let's reconvene in this thread after the PRs land. If anyone hits blockers ping me or escalate to eng-sre. :rocket:

Ben Ortiz: will do.

Liam Patel: thanks all.

Sophia Rivera: thanks!
